question: Four times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 46 years. After 7 years, three times Q’s age will be 41 years less than seven times P’s age at that time. What is the present age (in years) of Q?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let present ages be P and Q. Given: 4P − Q = 46 and 7(P + 7) − 3(Q + 7) = 41.

Simplify the second equation: 7P − 3Q = 13.

Multiply the first equation by 3: 12P − 3Q = 138.

Subtract the two equations: (12P − 7P) = 138 − 13 ⇒ 5P = 125 ⇒ P = 25.

Substitute P to find Q: Q = 4(25) − 46 = 54.

**∴ The correct answer is 54 years.**
